head: codex/101-github-route-guardrail
title: [csdlc-v2] Enforce repo-native GitHub lifecycle routes
body:
Closes #101

Defines one fail-closed Rust owner for each covered C-SDLC GitHub lifecycle surface and prohibits connector or raw-gh write fallback.

Adds a focused deterministic guard that:
- keeps root and boundary route-owner policy aligned
- classifies connector 403 failures without blaming the operator token or authorizing fallback
- exercises default and configured token-file precedence with redacted failures
- requires all four route-owner binaries in the verified installation inventory
- retains the dedicated proof command in the authoritative boundary

Validation:
- `cargo fmt --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml -- --check`
- `cargo test --manifest-path csdlc-v2/Cargo.toml --test gate_github_route_policy` (3 passed)
- `git diff --check`

Independent exact-head review at `fb2705e1ad3d019118611a76643b3e5e7bdd0b7c` found three focused coverage gaps; all were fixed and the rereview returned no actionable findings.

No token contents are retained, and no connector/raw-gh fallback is introduced.
